“Bad Sisters? What's that supposed to mean?”
“Well, they're Sisters, ain't they?”
“And they're bad?”
“Terrible. Everyone's running Bringers of Flame, winning tournaments. Proper respectable stuff.”
“And these?”
“Penitent Host.”
“Oh dear.”
“Exactly.”
“So they're bad because the list's rubbish?”
“Not just that. They're Repentia, mate. Been naughty. Done things the Emperor doesn't approve of innit. Now they're running about with chainswords trying to make up for it.”
“So they're bad Sisters playing a bad list?”
“Precisely.”
“And you reckon they'll win?”
“Course not. They're here to repent, not succeed.”
“...You're a proper nobhead, aren't you?”
